process.commandLine: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$client = [Net.Sockets.TcpClient]::new(); try { $connected = $client.ConnectAsync('1.1.1.1', 443).Wait(5000) } catch { $connected = $false } finally { $client.Dispose() }; if (-not $connected) { Write-Output 'OK:default_deny_tcp_blocked'; exit 0 }; Write-Output 'FAIL:default_deny_tcp_connected'; exit 1"
